_doc.purpose: Pixel-bounded floor/wall zones for Hu4Gzs open-plan office rebuild.
_doc.coordinateSpace: world pixels — matches furniture_catalog_openplan.json placement x/y (bottom-center anchor).
_doc.alignment: Bounds derived from office-scene.js floorZones + internal walls (x=848 divider, y=448 left split, y=256 right split). Placements span ~x:52–1228, y:64–700.

zones.name: Top wall decor band
zones.notes: North wall strip: whiteboards, bookshelf, framed certs, pop art, AC unit. Wall-mounted decor only — no floor furniture grid.

zones.name: Open-plan cubicles
zones.notes: Main bullpen — two rows of cubicle desks (front/back), divider panels, chairs, desk setups. Grey grid floor.

zones.name: Lounge
zones.notes: South-west lounge — L-sofa, 2-seat sofas, side table, wood plank floor, brick accent on west wall, money props, tall plants.

zones.name: Break / waiting
zones.notes: South-center break room — vending machine, 4-seat waiting row, water dispenser, wall cert. Door gap to lounge at x≈288–384.

zones.name: Side office (north-east)
zones.notes: Compact NE office — desk + monitor, executive chair, money bundles, optional sofa nook. Door gap on south wall at y≈160–256.

zones.name: Side office (south-east)
zones.notes: Larger SE office — box desk, two cubicle desks, coffee machine, cork board, bookshelf, rolling chairs. Spans y≈320–700.
